Harper Lin: Hey everyone, Harper here — thrilled to join Platform as an SRE! First day checklist question: my company Mac arrived with Apple DEP but I haven't received the Okta MDM invite or the VPN cert. Who should I ping?

Noah (People Ops): Welcome Harper!! :tada: Tagging IT. Also drop your desk/remote preference in the onboarding form if you haven't.

Eli (IT): Hi Harper, Eli from IT. I pushed an Okta Device Management invite to harper.lin@redwood.ai. Check Promotions/Spam. For VPN certs we use our internal PKI; I'll trigger a cert push once MDM enrolls. If nothing shows up reply with your laptop serial.

Harper Lin: Thanks Eli — checked spam, nothing. Serial is C02XYZ4ABC.

Eli (IT): Manual enroll token created and pushed. After you accept, run `profiles status -type enrollment` on macOS to ensure device is enrolled. I'll queue the VPN cert push as soon as MDM reports compliant.

onboard-bot: Provisioning event: created user harper.lin; added to GitHub teams: platform-sre; Slack channels: #platform,#oncall; GCP projects: infra-dev.

Harper Lin: Enrollment complete and shows "Compliant". Trying to SSH into the bastion gives `Permission denied (publickey)`. I added my pubkey to the onboarding repo under my GitHub handle but still blocked.

Jae (Platform): Welcome Harper! Make sure the key file is named `harper_lin.pub` inside onboarding-keys and contains a single ssh-ed25519 line. If it's there, @ops-bot can kick a sync. Ping me if you want a quick walkthrough of repo perms.

ops-bot: SSH key sync scheduled for harper.lin. ETA ~45s.

ops-bot: SSH key sync complete 0 keys propagated to jump hosts.

Harper Lin: SSH works now, awesome. VPN connects but I'm seeing intermittent DNS failures when resolving internal service names from the dev cluster. Who owns the split-DNS overrides?

Riley (Security): Hi Harper 0 Riley from Security. For split-DNS please open ops-ticket #3421 and attach `scutil --dns` + `dig` output. Infra-DNS team owns the overrides; we'll triage once we have the traces.

Harper Lin: Will file the ticket. Last quick Q: where's the first-week checklist and who pairs for on-call shadowing?

Noah (People Ops): Internal doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week. Jae and Samir usually run on-call pairing; I'll add you to the 2-week shadow rota and schedule a 1hr intro. Also: welcome kit (hoodie + stickers) is being shipped.

Jae (Platform): I'll schedule a 45m runbook + paging walkthrough this afternoon. Fun fact thread: what weird hobby do people bring?

Harper Lin: Fun fact: I build modular synth patches and collect vintage synth modules. Looking forward to the runbook and synth club.

Noah (People Ops): Synth club noted. Welcome aboard! :sparkles:
